messages:
Maria (oncall): Heads up — our planned 'kv-cache compaction' in us-west1 that was slated for 03:00 UTC is going to drift. infra informed me the host pre-checks are still running and the earliest start is 03:45 UTC. I need an on-call escalation plan + statuspage + customer note ready.

Ali (eng-sre): copying. what changed on the hosts? is this host drain or firmware?

Maria (oncall): Looks like node agent blocked on disk scrub; it's non-fatal but will delay drain by ~40m. infra says we can either wait for scrub to finish or move to alternate pool (extra risk for brief cache miss).

Jamie (support): tagging me for customer comms. we have ~6 active customers in the window who opted in for low-latency SLA testing. need short customer-facing line and hotline plan if things degrade.

incident-bot: Pager alert: SRE oncall Maria paged at 3012345682 for "maintenance-drift-us-west1"

Maria (oncall): acked. Ali, if we go to alternate pool, we'll need to TTL invalidate some KV prefixes and expect a few 10s-ms increased p95 for embeddings. If we wait, customers keep steady perf but window shifts. Preference?

Ali (eng-sre): prefer wait + communicate — less blast radius. if scrub extends beyond +1h, we'll execute fallback to alternate pool. I'll add a canary and throttled prefix-invalidations if we need fallback.

Lisa (product): agree with wait + communicate. product asks for a brief statuspage update we can push ASAP and a draft customer message for affected accounts. Also suggest a dedicated hotline (zoom + bg thread) if we need to escalate.

Maria (oncall): OK — action items: 1) publish provisional statuspage update that window is delayed to 03:45 and may shift further 2) send targeted customer email to customers who opted into that window 3) standby hotline and oncall handoff if window overlaps morning shift. Jamie, can you draft the customer note? Ali pls prepare rollback/fallback steps in runbook. I'll post the statuspage copy below.

Jamie (support): Draft customer copy below (short):

```
Subject: Brief delay to your scheduled maintenance window (us-west1)

Hi <CustomerFirstName>,

We're reaching out to let you know the maintenance we scheduled for us-west1 at 03:00 UTC will now begin at ~03:45 UTC due to an internal host pre-check. We do not expect impact to API availability. If we need to switch to an alternate pool to finish the work sooner, you may see a short period (seconds to a few minutes) of elevated latency for embeddings and cache-backed requests. We'll post updates on our status page and will notify you if the window extends beyond +1 hour.

If you have concerns or want to opt out of the maintenance, reply to this email and we will move your workload to a later window.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops Team
```

Maria (oncall): copy that; looks good. I'll make a tiny edit and publish. Proposed statuspage snippet: \"Maintenance delayed: compaction for kv-cache in us-west1 originally scheduled 03:00 UTC is starting later (ETA 03:45 UTC). No availability impact expected. Monitoring closely; updates to follow.\"

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook attached: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-compaction — sections: pre-checks, drain, alternate-pool-fallback, ttl-invalidation, post-verify. (See step 4.2 for forced-fallback commands)

Ali (eng-sre): I'll prep the fallback commands here so oncall can copy when needed:

```
# alternate pool failover (throttled)
redwoodctl route promote --pool alternate-usw1 --filter "kv-prefix:hot*" --throttle 10r/s
# incremental TTL invalidation
redwoodctl cache invalidate --prefix hot: --batch-size 500
```

Maria (oncall): good. Hotline plan: set up a temporary Zoom (ops-hotline link) and ping the slack thread when the hotline is live. If fallback executed, Ali will lead, Jamie will send a customer update, Lisa will approve messages. If scrubs finish and we start at 03:45, no hotline needed.

Jamie (support): I'll create the targeted customer DM list and queue emails now. Also prepping a one-paragraph statuspage email for enterprise contacts.

Maria (oncall): Hand-off: my shift ends at 04:30 UTC. If window is still active at 04:15 UTC I'll do a formal handoff to morning oncall. Leaving a short runbook note in the thread at 04:10 UTC.

incident-bot: Reminder: scheduled check-in at 03:30 UTC — please post current state and any change to start ETA.

Ali (eng-sre): monitoring metrics; disk-scrub progress at 62%. ETA ~25-35min. I'll post again at 03:30.

Maria (oncall): publishing provisional statuspage and firing off targeted emails now. Posting links here when done.

Maria (oncall): statuspage: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/us-west1-kv-compaction — message posted. Customer email queued to 6 accounts. Hotline created: https://zoom.redwood.ai/ops-hotline-742 (standby).

Lisa (product): thanks team. product will be on standby for any customer escalations. If we end up doing the fallback, marketing wants a one-sentence postmortem note template.

Jamie (support): noted — if fallback used, suggested postmortem sentence: \"We performed a controlled failover to an alternate pool to complete maintenance sooner; this caused a short, bounded increase in latency for a subset of cache-backed requests.\"

Maria (oncall): ok — last status update from me before handoff: scrub complete at 03:42 UTC, starting compaction at 03:46 UTC. No fallback needed. ramping TTL invalidation at low throttle to validate behavior. Will do final verify and close the thread once post-checks pass.

Ali (eng-sre): seeing minor p95 blips ~120ms for a minute during compaction — expected. Metrics trending to baseline.

Jamie (support): customer emails show 0 replies so far. no escalations.

Maria (oncall): post-checks green at 04:05 UTC. compaction finished, all hosts healthy. closing window and updating statuspage to COMPLETE + brief note. Thanks everyone for quick coordination.

Maria (oncall): statuspage update: \"COMPLETE — kv-cache compaction in us-west1 completed at 04:05 UTC. No sustained customer impact observed.\"

Lisa (product): closing note — good job. I'll draft the internal ops recap for tomorrow's retro.

Jamie (support): closing customer email template (follow-up) queued: 
```
Subject: Maintenance completed — us-west1

Hi <CustomerFirstName>,

The maintenance scheduled for your environment in us-west1 completed successfully at 04:05 UTC. We observed a short, bounded increase in latency for some cache-backed requests during compaction, but no sustained impact to availability. Please reach out if you saw anything we should investigate further.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support
```

Maria (oncall): thread closed. leaving a short runbook note and handoff summary in the runbook page.

sre-runbook-bot: Note recorded at 3012350448: "compaction-complete, no fallback used, scrub delayed start ~45min, metrics normal post-ops."

incident-bot: Thread closed at 3012350450.
